title: TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2611.05827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Native decision models remain close to chance in optimality verification. Paired tests reveal that some report better alternatives regardless

translated_title: TandemBench：面向多智能体协作的决策模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 决策模型在路由和动作选择等任务中从预定义选项中进行选择。在多智能体协作中，一个决策决定了成员如何分工、交换资源以及并行行动。我们提出了TandemBench，这是一个包含1,200个问题的基准测试，基于多智能体烹饪场景构建，其中协调选择会直接影响目标完成情况。模型接收完整的全局信息和候选团队计划，参考答案通过执行与精确搜索建立。模型需要选择最优团队计划，并在保留或移除该计划的成对变体中，判断在给定选项之外是否存在更优的安排。我们评估了40个原生决策模型，并将它们与10个通用语言模型进行比较。最佳原生决策模型达到62.50%的决策准确率。原生决策模型在最优性验证任务上的表现接近随机水平。成对测试显示，某些模型无论何种情况都会报告存在更好的替代方案。
tldr: 提出了TandemBench基准，通过1,200个多智能体烹饪协作问题系统评估决策模型的协作能力，发现原生决策模型最高仅达62.50%的决策准确率，且在验证方案最优性方面表现接近随机水平。
en_tdlr: We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 multi-agent cooking collaboration questions, revealing that the best native decision model achieves only 62.50% decision accuracy and performs near chance in optimality verification.
